name: Rocket School fonts
_note: RKT-002, the Sticker book look: Grandstander for titles and buttons, bundled rather than fetched, like the starter project's Inter, so a children's app renders offline and asks nothing of fonts.googleapis.com. Latin and Latin-extended subsets, because French needs œ (cœurs). SIL Open Font License 1.1; the licence travels beside it. Nunito, the body face, used to be bundled here too; since P88 GAM-016 the Playful preset brings it (noodl_modules/preset-font-nunito).
